question: How should parser recovery continue after malformed struct fields or enum variants?
decision: Recover each declaration member independently and synchronize at top-level commas or the declaration closing brace while tracking nested parenthesis, bracket, and generic-angle delimiters.

recovery_limit.within_member: stop after the first Parse diagnostic
recovery_limit.synchronization: top-level comma or declaration right brace
recovery_limit.later_stages: do not enter semantic or backend stages after any parse diagnostic

compatibility_boundary.exit_and_stdout: parse diagnostics still exit 1 and produce no stdout

rationale: Struct and enum member loops previously propagated a malformed member to the outer declaration. A delimiter-aware list boundary reports independent member failures and preserves later valid members without treating nested type punctuation as a declaration separator.
old_path_deletion_condition: Keep expression-internal list and match-arm recovery under separate M2B decisions with dedicated compatibility corpora.
